body.prose: That case, we don't know yet fully what's the best way to deal with dimensions. Is it just the space? Is it a special primitive? Or is it built upon the primitives? Like, you can build anything. Now, we might decide to give it its first class capability, as a space, but how is that differentiated from places that are the actual store of something? In comparison to placing things in a dimension, I just want to understand here that you're not hallucinating and that this is really clear for you.
body.title: Not yet known how to deal with dimensions
